capabilities: Execute any command via a leader hotkey followed by a mnemonic key sequence
Display a pop-up menu of valid keys and command groups while typing a sequence
Define custom keymaps in a YAML or Markdown file, extending or replacing the default keymap
Open vault files (including .canvas and .base) through key sequences
Activate the leader key on space when Vim mode is not in insert mode
extras: The README flags the "activate on space" setting as experimental, noting it may conflict with built-in functions or other plugins and does not work in some sidebars, Canvas, and Web viewer. It also lists five similar plugins (Leader Hotkeys, Sequence Hotkeys, Key Sequence Shortcut, Chorded hotkeys, Hotkeys Chords) with download counts.
problem: Obsidian's hotkey system requires assigning and memorizing many individual key combinations, and most built-in commands have no default hotkey.

relations.evidence: inspired by the Spacemacs Emacs distribution
This can be done with the help of the obsidian-vimrc-support plugin

summary: Leader-key plugin that runs Obsidian commands through mnemonic keypress sequences, with a pop-up menu and YAML-defined keymaps.
